Initial release of Crypto News Feed.

- Aggregates cryptocurrency news from top RSS sources.
- Filters articles by keywords, categories, sentiment, and recency.
- Performs sentiment analysis and applies a clear scoring system.
- Generates daily HTML digest reports summarizing trends, sentiment, and top stories.
- Includes commands to manage RSS sources, view trending topics, and automate daily digests.
- Provides built-in keyword categories for DeFi, NFT, Layer 2, Regulation, and Meme news.
